title: Squared differences and energy
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $F$ be a rational-valued function on its vertices. The sum, over all vertices and neighbor indices, of the squared difference between $F$ at the vertex and at its indexed neighbor is $2D$ times the sum over vertices of $F(u)$ multiplied by the difference between $F(u)$ and its neighbor average.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
$F$ is a rational-valued function on the vertices
